In qualità di apprendista di assicurazioni a Zurich Benelux, diventerai parte del team di Surety mentre avrai anche la possibilità di ruotare verso altre 2 squadre ospitanti (ad esempio Claims, Sales ecc.) per ottenere una migliore comprensione del nostro business.

Questo programma offre una forte attenzione all'apprendimento pratico e all'integrazione profonda con il nostro business, permettendo di costruire competenze, mentre davvero fare un impatto.

Informazioni su Zurich Insurance Benelux

L'assicurazione di Zurigo Benelux fa parte del gruppo di assicurazione di Zurigo, e un'assicurazione commerciale leader che sostiene le imprese locali e internazionali. Siamo nel business di aiutare i clienti a gestire il rischio e costruire resilienza in un mondo in continua evoluzione. Zurigo impiega oltre 60.000 persone a livello globale, creando uno spazio in cui è possibile sviluppare professionalmente, spingere i propri limiti e contribuire in modi significativi. Le tue prospettive sono valutate a Zurigo. Sosteniamo la curiosità e ti diamo il potere di essere il CEO della tua carriera.

Come apprendista in Surety Underwriting , sei coinvolto sia nella sottoscrizione di garanzia & emissione così come la sottoscrizione del cliente. Il nostro team Surety è unico all'interno di Zurigo in quanto emettiamo obbligazioni (garanzie bancarie) piuttosto che assicurazioni tradizionali, sostenendo le aziende di medie dimensioni e grandi dimensioni in tutti i settori. La sottoscrizione del cliente è correlata alla valutazione della situazione finanziaria e delle prestazioni dei nostri clienti analizzando le loro informazioni finanziarie, inclusi bilanci, cash flow e finanziamento. In questo ruolo, si lavora a stretto contatto con CFO e altri decisori di finanza senior.

Il programma di tirocinio a colpo d'occhio

- Programma strutturato di 16 mesi (tramite un contratto open-end)

- Inizia a settembre 2026

- Completamente basato dal nostro ufficio olandese a L'Aia

- Combinazione di squadra casa Surety e rotazione squadra ospite

- Preparazione per un ruolo a lungo termine (giunitario) nel Benelux di Zurigo

Struttura del programma

- Home team (6 mesi)
Si inizia a Surety Underwriting come Home Team dove si assume responsabilità fondamentali e costruire una solida base. Questo è anche il team a cui tornerai dopo aver completato il programma.

- 2 rotazione del team host di 5 mesi ciascuno
Le rotazioni del team host sono progettate per ampliare la vostra prospettiva esponendovi a diversi lati del nostro business. Potrai lavorare su assegnazioni hands-on, value-adding, sviluppare nuove competenze e ottenere una visione aziendale più profonda.

- Gennaio 2028
Torni alla tua squadra di casa Surety, pronta a iniziare in un ruolo junior con una solida base di esperienza.

Tu porti:

- Laurea o Master (preferibilmente in Economia, Finanza, Contabilità, Diritto commerciale o equivalente) e 0–2 anni di esperienza lavorativa

- Fluenza in olandese e in inglese (non negoziabile)

- Lei risiede nei Paesi Bassi (e disponibile a partire da settembre 2026)

- Una mentalità collaborativa e la volontà di imparare

- Interessi di assicurazione, finanza e sviluppo personale

Cosa offriamo

- Un programma di sviluppo strutturato con responsabilità reali

- On-the-job coaching e mentoring di colleghi esperti

- Esposizione a diverse squadre e prospettive di business

- Opportunità di formazione per sostenere la crescita professionale

- Un ambiente di lavoro favorevole e inclusivo

- Punto di partenza per una carriera a lungo termine all'interno di Zurich Benelux

Come applicare

Quando si applica, si prega di presentare:

- Il tuo CV

- Un breve testo di motivazione personalizzato, scritto nelle tue parole, spiegando:

- perché sei interessato al tirocinio di assicurazione

- cosa ti motiva a iniziare la tua carriera con Zurich Insurance Benelux.

Diversità e inclusione

A Zurigo, ci impegniamo a creare un posto di lavoro inclusivo dove tutti si sentono valorizzati e rispettati. Accogliamo le applicazioni da tutti i background e non discriminano in base a genere, età, disabilità, nazionalità, etnia, orientamento sessuale, religione, o qualsiasi altra caratteristica protetta.

Sii sfidato. Sii ispirato. Aiutaci a fare la differenza.

En tant que stagiaire d'assurance à Zurich Benelux, vous deviendrez membre de l'équipe d'accueil de Surety tout en obtenant la possibilité de tourner vers 2 autres équipes d'accueil (par exemple les réclamations, les ventes, etc.) pour mieux comprendre notre entreprise.

Ce programme met fortement l'accent sur l'apprentissage pratique et l'intégration profonde avec notre entreprise, vous permettant de développer l'expertise tout en faisant vraiment un impact.

À propos de Zurich Assurance Benelux

Zurich Insurance Benelux fait partie du groupe d'assurances Zurich et est un assureur commercial de premier plan qui soutient les entreprises locales et internationales. Nous aidons les clients à gérer les risques et à renforcer leur résilience dans un monde en constante évolution. - Exposition à différentes équipes et perspectives d'affaires

descriptionByLocale.it:
Dove la tua carriera ti porterà dopo? Scopriamo insieme.

A Zurigo Cover-More, siamo orgogliosi di essere uno dei principali fornitori di assicurazione e assistenza al mondo. Ogni anno, proteggiamo più di 20 milioni di viaggiatori in tutto il mondo, assicurandoci di esserci ogni passo del loro viaggio con cura proattiva, copertura personalizzata e supporto specializzato. I partner di Zurigo Cover-More con molti dei marchi più noti al mondo – pensano alle principali compagnie aeree, ai giganti di viaggio, alle principali banche, ai fornitori di carte di credito e ai grandi rivenditori – per fornire maggiore cura, maggiore copertura, per tutti.

Lanciato nel dicembre 2024, Zurich Cover-More è il marchio di viaggi globale del Zurich Insurance Group, uno dei principali assicuratori multi-linee al mondo. La nostra famiglia di marchi di customer-facing comprende nomi fidati come Travel Guard, Cover-More Travel Insurance, Travelex Insurance, Universal Assistance, World Travel Protection, Freely e Blue Insurance. Insieme, stiamo ridefinindo cosa significa viaggiare in modo sicuro e con fiducia. Che si tratti di una vacanza a lungo attesa, di un viaggio d’affari dell’ultimo minuto o di una deviazione inaspettata, offriamo nei momenti che contano.

Informazioni su Travel Guard

Questo ruolo fa parte del nostro team di Travel Guard. Travel Guard è un marchio di assicurazione di viaggio leader, che serve milioni di turisti e viaggiatori d'affari in tutto il mondo. Fondata nel 1982, offriamo un portafoglio completo di soluzioni di assicurazione di viaggio e servizi di assistenza globale. Travel Guard opera centri di assistenza in Asia, Europa e America, garantendo un supporto 24/7 per aiutare i viaggiatori a navigare in circostanze inaspettate che potrebbero interrompere i loro piani. La Guardia di viaggio entrò a far parte di Zurigo Cover-More nel dicembre 2024.

Cosa farai:

In questo ruolo, fornirete un supporto paralegale completo al team legale del Nord America, lavorando in una vasta gamma di questioni legali, regolamentari e aziendali in un ambiente dinamico e veloce.

- Redazione, revisione, coordinamento e gestione di contratti commerciali e documenti legali

- Condurre la ricerca legale e preparare i riassunti su argomenti normativi e legali sotto la guida di avvocato

- Assistere con le risposte alle indagini regolamentari e alle questioni relative alla conformità

- Revisione dei materiali di marketing, pubblicità e comunicazioni esterne per la conformità legale e regolamentare

- Coordinare i progetti legali, compresi i termini di tracciamento, il mantenimento della documentazione e il seguito su elementi di azione

- Liaise con stakeholder interfunzionali per raccogliere input e sostenere processi di revisione legale efficienti

- Gestisci il controllo dei documenti, inclusa la versione, le copie di esecuzione e il corretto deposito legale e archiviazione

- Sostenere i processi di esecuzione dei contratti e garantire la registrazione accurata degli accordi conclusi

- Programmare e coordinare riunioni e comunicazioni per avvocati, compresa la collaborazione transfrontaliera

- Fornire supporto amministrativo e operativo generale al team legale come necessario

Quali competenze e esperienza porterete in questo viaggio:

Essenziale:

- Certificato paralegale, grado associato o equivalente esperienza rilevante

- 3+ anni di esperienza in un ruolo di supporto paralegale o legale

- Esperienza dei processi di revisione del contratto di supporto sotto supervisione dell'avvocato

- Forte capacità organizzativa con la capacità di gestire più priorità

- Eccellente capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale

- Dimostrata attenzione ai dettagli e capacità di gestire le informazioni sensibili con discrezione

Where will your career take you next? Let’s find out together.

At Zurich Cover-More, we’re proud to be one of the world’s leading travel insurance and assistance providers. Each year, we protect more than 20 million travellers worldwide, making sure we’re there every step of their journey with proactive care, personalised cover and specialist support. Zurich Cover-More partners with many of the world’s best-known brands – think major airlines, travel giants, top banks, credit card providers, and large retailers – to deliver more care, more cover, for all.

Launched in December 2024, Zurich Cover-More is the global travel brand of Zurich Insurance Group, one of the world’s leading multi-line insurers. Our family of customer-facing brands includes trusted names like Travel Guard, Cover-More Travel Insurance, Travelex Insurance, Universal Assistance, World Travel Protection, Freely, and Blue Insurance. Together, we’re redefining what it means to travel safely and with confidence. Whether it’s a long-awaited holiday, a last-minute business trip, or an unexpected detour, we deliver in the moments that matter.

About Travel Guard

This role is part of our Travel Guard team. Travel Guard is a leading travel insurance brand, serving millions of leisure and business travellers worldwide. Established in 1982, we offer a comprehensive portfolio of travel insurance solutions and global assistance services. Travel Guard operates service centres across Asia, Europe, and the Americas, ensuring 24/7 support to help travellers navigate unexpected circumstances that may disrupt their plans. Travel Guard became part of Zurich Cover-More in December 2024.

What you’ll be doing:

In this role, you will provide comprehensive paralegal support to the North America Legal team, working across a wide range of legal, regulatory, and business matters in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.

- Support drafting, reviewing, coordinating, and administering commercial contracts and legal documents

- Conduct legal research and prepare summaries on regulatory and legal topics under attorney guidance

- Assist with responses to regulatory inquiries and compliance-related matters

- Review marketing, advertising, and external communications materials for legal and regulatory compliance

- Coordinate legal projects, including tracking deadlines, maintaining documentation, and following up on action items

- Liaise with cross-functional stakeholders to gather inputs and support efficient legal review processes

- Manage document control, including versioning, execution copies, and proper legal filing and storage

- Support contract execution processes and ensure accurate recordkeeping of finalized agreements

- Schedule and coordinate meetings and communications for attorneys, including cross-border collaboration

- Provide general administrative and operational support to the Legal team as needed

What skills and experience you’ll bring on this journey:

Essential:

- Paralegal certificate, associate degree, or equivalent relevant experience

- 3+ years of experience in a paralegal or legal support role

- Experience supporting contract review processes under attorney supervision

- Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills

- Demonstrated attention to detail and ability to handle sensitive information with discretion

Preferred:

- Experience supporting regulatory or compliance-related legal work

- Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment

- Proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with strong problem-solving skills

Why you’ll love working with us!

We value optimism, caring, togetherness, reliability, results-orientation, and forward-thinking.

We have more than 3000 employees worldwide. We are a global group of digital specialists, actuaries, marketers, doctors, nurses, case managers, claims specialists, finance experts, customer service and corporate services professionals. We share a global purpose to look after travellers, at every step of their journey.

Job flexibility. We understand the importance of making sure that work fits into your life, not the other way around. Our hybrid approach ensures you can maintain work-life balance with the flexibility of 3 days in the office and 2 days working from home.

Career growth. This is an extremely exciting time for us at Zurich Cover-More, as we rapidly expand our business across the globe. We’re committed to helping our people thrive through a comprehensive onboarding experience, continuous professional development, and a supportive work environment that empowers growth at every stage of your career.

Take the time you need, for you and your community. We encourage you to take the time you need when you need it. We offer regular annual and personal leave benefits along with volunteer leave and a comprehensive paid parental leave scheme.

Investing in your health and your future. We offer a competitive high-deductible health plan, EAP programs, and access to health and well-being activities, along with a 401(k) program with employer matching to help you plan for your future.

Diversity and inclusion. We respect who you are and thoroughly embrace diversity. Wherever life has taken you, we welcome you to bring your whole self to work. Just be you – because that’s exactly who we’re looking for.

Apply today and let’s go to great places together!

Location: Schaumburg, IL (preferred) or Remote

Zurich Cover-More arbeitet mit vielen der bekanntesten Marken der Welt zusammen - denken Sie an große Fluggesellschaften, Reisegiganten, Top-Banken, Kreditkartenanbieter und große Einzelhändler -, um mehr Pflege, mehr Deckung für alle zu bieten.

Zurich Cover-More wurde im Dezember 2024 gegründet und ist die globale Reisemarke der Zurich Insurance Group, einem der weltweit führenden Multiline-Versicherer. Unsere Familie von kundenorientierten Marken umfasst vertrauenswürdige Namen wie Travel Guard, Cover-More Travel Insurance, Travelex Insurance, Universal Assistance, World Travel Protection, Freely und Blue Insurance. Gemeinsam definieren wir neu, was es bedeutet, sicher und vertrauensvoll zu reisen. Ob es sich um einen lang erwarteten Urlaub, eine Geschäftsreise in letzter Minute oder einen unerwarteten Umweg handelt, wir liefern in den Momenten, die wichtig sind.

Über Travel Guard

Diese Rolle ist Teil unseres Travel Guard Teams. Travel Guard ist eine führende Reiseversicherungsmarke, die Millionen von Urlaubs- und Geschäftsreisenden weltweit betreut. Gegründet 1982, bieten wir ein umfassendes Portfolio an Reiseversicherungslösungen und globalen Assistenzdiensten. Travel Guard betreibt Servicezentren in Asien, Europa und Amerika und bietet 24/7-Support, um Reisenden zu helfen, unerwartete Umstände zu bewältigen, die ihre Pläne stören könnten. Travel Guard wurde im Dezember 2024 Teil von Zurich Cover-More.

Was du tun wirst:

In dieser Rolle bieten Sie dem North America Legal-Team umfassende juristische Unterstützung und arbeiten in einer Vielzahl von rechtlichen, regulatorischen und geschäftlichen Angelegenheiten in einem dynamischen und schnelllebigen Umfeld.

- Unterstützung bei der Erstellung, Überprüfung, Koordination und Verwaltung von Handelsverträgen und rechtlichen Dokumenten

- Durchführung von Rechtsrecherchen und Erstellung von Zusammenfassungen zu regulatorischen und rechtlichen Themen unter Anleitung von Anwälten

- Unterstützung bei Antworten auf regulatorische Anfragen und Compliance-bezogene Angelegenheiten

- Überprüfung von Marketing-, Werbe- und externen Kommunikationsmaterialien zur Einhaltung gesetzlicher und behördlicher Vorschriften

- Koordinieren Sie rechtliche Projekte, einschließlich der Nachverfolgung von Fristen, der Dokumentation und der Nachverfolgung von Maßnahmen

- Verbindung mit funktionsübergreifenden Stakeholdern, um Inputs zu sammeln und effiziente rechtliche Überprüfungsprozesse zu unterstützen

- Verwalten Sie die Dokumentenkontrolle, einschließlich Versionierung, Ausführungskopien und ordnungsgemäße rechtliche Einreichung und Speicherung

- Unterstützen Sie die Vertragsausführungsprozesse und gewährleisten Sie eine genaue Aufzeichnung der abgeschlossenen Vereinbarungen

- Planung und Koordinierung von Sitzungen und Mitteilungen für Rechtsanwälte, einschließlich der grenzüberschreitenden Zusammenarbeit

- Bereitstellung allgemeiner administrativer und operativer Unterstützung für das Legal-Team nach Bedarf

Welche Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen Sie auf dieser Reise mitbringen werden:

Wesentlich:

- Paralegal Certificate, Associate Degree oder gleichwertige relevante Erfahrung

- 3+ Jahre Erfahrung in einer paralegalen oder rechtlichen Unterstützung Rolle

- Erfahrung in der Unterstützung von Vertragsüberprüfungsprozessen unter Aufsicht von Anwälten

- Starke organisatorische Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, mehrere Prioritäten zu verwalten

- Hervorragende schriftliche und verbale Kommunikationsfähigkeiten

- Demonstrierte Aufmerksamkeit für Details und Fähigkeit, sensible Informationen mit Diskretion zu behandeln

Bevorzugt:

- Erfahrung in der Unterstützung regulatorischer oder Compliance-bezogener juristischer Arbeit

- Fähigkeit, in einer schnelllebigen, funktionsübergreifenden Umgebung effektiv zu arbeiten

- Proaktives, lösungsorientiertes Mindset mit starken Problemlösungskompetenzen

Warum Sie es lieben werden, mit uns zu arbeiten!

Wir schätzen Optimismus, Fürsorge, Zusammengehörigkeit, Zuverlässigkeit, Ergebnisorientierung und vorausschauendes Denken.

Wir haben weltweit mehr als 3000 Mitarbeiter. Wir sind eine globale Gruppe von digitalen Spezialisten, Versicherungsmathematikern, Vermarktern, Ärzten, Krankenschwestern, Case Managern, Schadensspezialisten, Finanzexperten, Kundendienst- und Unternehmensdienstleistern. Wir teilen das globale Ziel, Reisende bei jedem Schritt ihrer Reise zu betreuen.

Arbeitsplatzflexibilität. Wir verstehen, wie wichtig es ist, sicherzustellen, dass Arbeit in Ihr Leben passt, nicht umgekehrt. Unser hybrider Ansatz stellt sicher, dass Sie die Work-Life-Balance mit der Flexibilität von 3 Tagen im Büro und 2 Tagen von zu Hause aus halten können.

Karrierewachstum. Dies ist eine äußerst aufregende Zeit für uns bei Zurich Cover-More, da wir unser Geschäft schnell auf der ganzen Welt ausbauen. Wir sind bestrebt, unseren Mitarbeitern durch eine umfassende Onboarding-Erfahrung, kontinuierliche berufliche Entwicklung und ein unterstützendes Arbeitsumfeld zu helfen, das Wachstum in jeder Phase Ihrer Karriere ermöglicht.

Nimm dir die Zeit, die du brauchst, für dich und deine Gemeinschaft. Wir empfehlen Ihnen, sich die Zeit zu nehmen, die Sie brauchen, wenn Sie sie brauchen. Investieren in Ihre Gesundheit und Ihre Zukunft. Wir bieten einen wettbewerbsfähigen Gesundheitsplan mit hohem Selbstbehalt, EAP-Programme und Zugang zu Gesundheits- und Wohlbefindensaktivitäten sowie ein 401 (k) -Programm mit Arbeitgeber-Matching, um Ihnen bei der Planung Ihrer Zukunft zu helfen.

Job Title: UA Associate

Description
Zurich North America is currently hiring a UA Associate to join the SP Energy Property team! As a UA Associate, you will support and work closely with experienced Underwriters in the review and analysis of risks. You will enjoy the opportunity to fully apply and hone your research and analytical skills to effectively assess risk and grow your career.

At Zurich North America we acknowledge that work life-balance and flexibility are a priority when it comes to choosing your next career move. Designed with our employees' needs in mind, the ZNA hybrid work model emphasizes flexibility, allowing employees to conduct individual work in their preferred location, while facilitating in-person connections and collaborative activities when meaningful and valuable. While the model provides a high level of flexibility and autonomy, occasional circumstances requiring in-office attendance should be expected.

This is a hybrid work position; however, the candidate selected for this opportunity should be able to report into one of the following North American office locations: New York, NY.

Responsibilities
- Reviews, evaluates, and summarizes risk exposures, controls, loss history, and financial condition to aid underwriting decisions around submission acceptance or declination.
- Follows instructions from Underwriters in areas of policy rating, subjective pricing, policy construction, coverages & exclusions, mandatory forms, etc. to accurately quote and issue policies.
- Provides account servicing support in collaboration with Underwriter and Manager, with responsibility for end-to-end servicing processes for new business, renewals, and endorsements for basic to moderately complex business and products.
- Responds to written, verbal telephone inquiries appropriately and on time under close supervision by Underwriter and/or Manager. Working collaboratively with assigned underwriters.
- Supports Underwriter with broker/agent/distributor/customer interactions by providing basic customer service skills.

Requirements

- Bachelor’s degree and no prior experience in the Administrative, Customer Service, Financial Services, Risk Management, or Insurance area
- OR
- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice, including Associate Degree and no prior experience in the Administrative, Customer Service, Financial Services, Risk Management, or Insurance area
- OR
- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 2 or more years of experience in the Administrative, Customer Service, Financial Services, Risk Management, or Insurance area
- AND
- Knowledge of data collection and analysis
- Microsoft Office experience
- Preferred Qualifications:
- Insurance industry knowledge
- Knowledge of processing, rating and policy management systems used in the insurance industry
- Strong verbal and written communication skills
- Superior skills in relationship building, active listening with customers and coworkers
- Customer service experience
- Enjoys working with details and providing accurate data in a timely manner
- Self-directed to meet deadlines
- Multi-tasking skills

Zurich is currently looking to hire an Energy Casualty Executive Underwriter or AVP Underwriting Director to join the team in Houston, TX.

The primary Casualty Energy Underwriter will analyze and underwrite highly complex new and renewal business, under minimal direction, utilizing The Zurich Way of Underwriting Framework as a subject matter expert, ensuring a high-level service to customers. As a Senior Underwriter will serve as a leader and mentor to the team offering technical guidance on key coverage issues and forms. In this role you will handle Texas and will be tasked with building strong broker relationships.

The hiring manager will determine the appropriate level based upon the selected applicant’s experience and skillset relative to the qualifications listed for this position

Responsibilities include:

- Serving as a customer industry advocate with a focus on improving the customer experience by understanding their risk and offering the best end to end solution for their insurance needs.

- Using a disciplined approach to exposure evaluation, risk assessment and pricing

- Using risk insights, data and models to drive informed decisions at point of sale

- Market facing and production within the Energy Casualty division

- Administering and monitoring underwriting rules and guidelines, insurance laws and regulations and rating manual rules

- Working within broad limits and authorities on highly complex assignments

This role will be filled at either the Executive Underwriter or AVP, Underwriting Director level. The hiring manager will determine the appropriate level based upon the selected applicant’s experience and skill set relative to the qualifications listed for this position.

Basic Qualifications: Executive Underwriter-Energy Casualty

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 5 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area
OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 10 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 3 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 8 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area

OR

Basic Qualifications: AVP, UW Director - Energy Casualty

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 7 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area.
OR

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 14 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 5 or more years of experience in the Underwriting or Market Facing area
OR

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice including an Associate Degree and 12 or more years of experience in the Claims or Underwriting Support area
AND

- Experience with Microsoft Office

Preferred Qualifications:

- Bachelors Degree

- Technical knowledge of Commercial Casualty Underwriting

- Established broker relationships (Retail, select brokers) in the Houston Region

- Sales execution mindset

- Creative problem solving skills

- Strong verbal and written communication skills

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us. The combined salary range for this position is $105,300.00 - $227,900.00. The proposed salary range for the Executive Underwriter is $105,300.00 - $172,400.00, with Global Specialty Incentive Plan bonus eligibility set at 30% . The proposed salary range for the AVP Underwriting Director is $139,200.00 - $227,900.00, with Global Specialty Incentive Plan bonus eligibility set at 40% .

We offer competitive pay and comprehensive benefits for employees and their families. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

At Zurich, we value your ideas and experience. We offer growth, inclusion, and a supportive environment—so you can help shape the future of insurance. Zurich North America is a leader in risk management, with over 150 years of expertise and coverage across 25+ industries, including 90% of the Fortune 500®.

Join us for a brighter future—for yourself and our customers.

In this role you will be responsible for:

- Drafting legal pleadings, correspondence, and other documents as directed

- Providing legal support such as legal and documentary research

- Monitoring and adhering to case schedules and filing deadlines

- Conducting interviews, summarizing depositions, reviewing discovery responses and medical records

- Preparing discovery requests and responses

- Subpoenaing, collecting and organizing records from non-parties

- Scheduling Surveillance, Compulsory Medical Exams, and Site Inspections

- Assisting in trial preparation

- Responding to inquiries from and interacting with customers, clients, counsel, and witnesses

- Organizing and maintaining case files and documentation, electronically

- Contributing to the team effort by accomplishing related results and participating on projects as needed

- Collaborating with attorneys, staff, claims professionals and leadership to accomplish successful business and litigation outcomes.

Basic Qualifications:

- High School Diploma or Equivalent and 4 or more years of experience in the Legal Support area

OR

- Associate Degree and 2 or more years of experience in the Legal Support area

AND

- Experience conducting electronic database research

- Experience drafting legal documents, correspondence, and/or pleadings

- Experience in legal support

- Experience with Microsoft Office

Additional requirement for California only:
Paralegals must meet one of the following requirements:

- Have a paralegal certificate from an ABA-approved program
OR

- Have a certificate from an accredited paralegal program with at least 24 semester units of law-related courses
OR

- Have a bachelor's degree or higher and one year of law-related experience under the supervision of a California-licensed attorney who has been practicing for the past three years (or an attorney who's practiced in California federal courts for the past three years).

Preferred Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s Degree or Paralegal Certificate

- Defense experience

- Insurance industry experience

- Ability to effectively conduct electronic database research, including Lexus Nexis

- Comfortable working in a paperless work environment

- Strong written and verbal communication skills.

- Ability to effectively draft legal documents, correspondence, and/or pleadings

- Strong Microsoft Office and technical skills

- Familiarity with litigation management software systems

- Trial experience, including preparing trial exhibits and witnesses

- Experiencing filing with the California Courts E-filing system.

- Familiarity with California Rules of Civil Procedure and local Rules

- Experience navigating Clerk, Court and Judicial websites

descriptionByLocale.en:
A new transformational adventure awaits you…

How does 5 weeks leave per year, an impactful career that you’ll truly love, and working for a trustworthy organisation that empowers wellbeing and is accelerating digital transformation sound like to you?

As one of Forbes 2024 ‘World’s Best Employers’ and Fortune's ‘World's Most Admired Companies’ for 2025, Zurich - a leader in the insurance industry - is on a journey towards a brighter future… A brighter future for you - focused on your career, your wellbeing, and your community - as well as our customers and the planet.

This exciting adventure will drive positive impact towards our vision to be Australia’s leading digital insurer. So, if you want to be part of a values led global organisation, where real growth and transformation is happening, along with our track record of making a real difference of continuously taking steps toward a sustainable future for our people, customers, communities, and our planet…read on!

Let’s create a brighter future together, let’s make a difference

It's important to know, what you do matters. At Zurich, we don't just cover, we care.

An exciting opportunity exists to join Zurich’s General Insurance business as a Senior Data Analyst within our Delegated Programs team, reporting to the Partnerships Portfolio Manager.

Zurich’s GI business protects our customers’ people, property and operations through a broad range of retail and commercial insurance solutions. Within GI, our Delegated Programs team builds and manages strategic partnerships that extend Zurich’s reach, deliver tailored propositions and create seamless experiences for end customers.

Working closely with underwriting, claims, product, digital and operations, the team uses data and insights to optimise performance, improve customer outcomes and identify new opportunities for profitable growth. In this role, you’ll turn complex data into meaningful insights that support strategic and operational decision-making across Zurich. You’ll independently lead analysis, reporting and data-driven initiatives, partnering with stakeholders to understand their needs and deliver high-quality, timely solutions that make a real business impact.

This is a great opportunity for an analytically minded professional who enjoys solving problems, influencing decisions and helping teams use data in a consistent, secure and compliant way. If you’re looking to apply your technical skills in a customer-focused, commercially important area of the business, this could be the next step in your career.

Important to your success - Unlock your potential

- Strong experience in data analysis or a related analytics role, ideally within financial services or insurance.

- Confidence leading complex analytics projects from scoping and planning through to delivery.

- Ability to build trusted relationships and influence senior stakeholders in an advisory-style role.

- Hands-on experience developing dashboards, reports and data models that support clear decision-making.

- Experience working with large datasets and multiple data sources in a controlled environment.

- A talent for turning business questions into analytical solutions and actionable insights.

Belong. Zurich is here to support you

There are so many reasons why Zurich is a great place to be and the right choice for you, but here are just a few.

- 5 weeks leave per year for permanent staff through our Z leave initiative, as well as 15 days personal/carer’s leave (as we empower our people to manage their own wellbeing), plus access to Family Care (parental leave)

- Hybrid working arrangement - office 3 days and WFH 2 days p/w standard for FT employees

- Access programs to stay healthy and feel healthier along with receiving a AUD$500 wellbeing payment per year, plus an AUD$295 new starter e-voucher for your WFH set up (flex work - hybrid working), and other great benefits through our Shine portal

- Grow, and thrive in your career (we support and encourage it) with award winning training programs. As our strength is our people and we value your individuality

- Work with global, diverse, and inclusive teams; Explore your passions, fuel innovation, drive equity, collaborate and make a positive difference beyond your role

- Global mobility opportunities across more than 200 countries worldwide

- Volunteer and work in our state-of-the-art Green Star rated offices (when you are in the office) and dress for your day

- We plant a tree for every new employee

- Not to mention our various employer of choice awards/memberships – WGEA; Family Inclusive workplace; Gold AWEI employer, Pride in diversity… to name a few.

We could go on, but the main point is that Zurich is a great place to be, where you can truly belong, be yourself, have work/life balance, and thrive in a supportive environment.

Zurich is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to ensuring that our recruitment process is fair and accessible for all candidates. If you require any special accommodations to participate in our recruitment process, we encourage you to please let us know at the time of your application.

So, if you want to come on an adventure that will build a brighter future together, and feel a sense of togetherness, then please apply today to start your adventure !
descriptionByLocale.it:
Una nuova avventura trasformazionale vi aspetta...

Come vanno 5 settimane all’anno, una carriera d’impatto che adorerai davvero, e lavorare per un’organizzazione affidabile che potenzia il benessere e sta accelerando il suono della trasformazione digitale come a te?

Come uno dei Forbes 2024 ‘World’s Best Employers’ e ‘World’s Most Admired Companies’ di Fortune per il 2025, Zurigo - leader nel settore assicurativo - è in un viaggio verso un futuro più luminoso... Un futuro più luminoso per voi - focalizzato sulla vostra carriera, il vostro benessere, e la vostra comunità - così come i nostri clienti e il pianeta.

Questa entusiasmante avventura porterà un impatto positivo verso la nostra visione per essere l’insurrezione digitale leader dell’Australia. Quindi, se vuoi far parte di un'organizzazione globale guidata da valori, dove sta accadendo la crescita reale e la trasformazione, insieme al nostro track record di fare una vera differenza di fare continuamente passi verso un futuro sostenibile per il nostro popolo, clienti, comunità e il nostro pianeta...read on!

Creiamo un futuro più luminoso insieme, facciamo la differenza

E' importante sapere cosa fai. A Zurigo, non copriamo, ci interessa.

Esiste un’opportunità entusiasmante per unire l’attività di Assicurazione Generale di Zurigo come Analista di Dati Senior all’interno del nostro team di Programmi Delegati, segnalando al Responsabile Portfolio Partnerships.

Il business GI di Zurigo protegge le persone, le proprietà e le operazioni dei nostri clienti attraverso una vasta gamma di soluzioni di assicurazione al dettaglio e commerciale. All’interno di GI, il nostro team Delegated Programs costruisce e gestisce partnership strategiche che estendono la portata di Zurigo, offrono proposte su misura e creano esperienze senza soluzione di continuità per i clienti finali.

Lavorando a stretto contatto con la sottoscrizione, i reclami, il prodotto, il digitale e le operazioni, il team utilizza dati e approfondimenti per ottimizzare le prestazioni, migliorare i risultati dei clienti e identificare nuove opportunità di crescita redditizia. In questo ruolo, trasformerai dati complessi in approfondimenti significativi che supportano il processo decisionale strategico e operativo in tutta Zurigo. Potrai condurre in modo indipendente le iniziative di analisi, reporting e data-driven, collaborando con gli stakeholder per comprendere le loro esigenze e fornire soluzioni tempestive di alta qualità che rendono un impatto reale sul business.

Questa è una grande opportunità per un professionista analiticamente consapevole che gode di risolvere i problemi, influenzare le decisioni e aiutare i team a utilizzare i dati in modo coerente, sicuro e conforme. Se stai cercando di applicare le tue competenze tecniche in una zona commerciale e focalizzata sul cliente, questo potrebbe essere il prossimo passo nella tua carriera.

Importante per il vostro successo - Sblocca il vostro potenziale

- Una forte esperienza nell'analisi dei dati o un ruolo di analisi correlato, idealmente all'interno di servizi finanziari o assicurazioni.

- Confidenza leader di progetti di analisi complessi da scoping e pianificazione fino alla consegna.

- Capacità di costruire relazioni di fiducia e influenzare gli stakeholder senior in un ruolo di consulenza-stile.

- Esperienza pratica nello sviluppo di dashboard, report e modelli di dati che supportano il processo decisionale chiaro.

- Prova a lavorare con grandi set di dati e più sorgenti di dati in un ambiente controllato.

- Un talento per trasformare le domande aziendali in soluzioni analitiche e intuizioni attuabili.

Da un po'. Zurigo è qui per sostenervi

Ci sono tanti motivi per cui Zurigo è un ottimo posto per essere e la scelta giusta per voi, ma qui ci sono solo alcuni.

- 5 settimane di congedo all'anno per il personale permanente attraverso la nostra iniziativa di congedo Z, così come 15 giorni di congedo personale/carer (come diamo il potere alle nostre persone di gestire il proprio benessere), oltre l'accesso alla Famiglia Care (parentale)

- Sistema di lavoro ibrido - ufficio 3 giorni e WFH 2 giorni p/w standard per i dipendenti FT

- Programmi di accesso per rimanere sano e sentirsi più sano con la ricezione di un pagamento di benessere AUD$500 all'anno, più un nuovo e-voucher di avviamento AUD$295 per la vostra configurazione WFH (lavoro flessibile - lavoro ibrido), e altri grandi vantaggi attraverso il nostro portale Shine

- Crescere, e prosperare nella vostra carriera (supportiamo e incoraggiamo) con programmi di formazione vincenti premio. Poiché la nostra forza è la nostra gente e apprezziamo la vostra individualità

- Lavorare con team globali, diversi e inclusivi; Esplora le tue passioni, l'innovazione del carburante, l'equità di guida, collabora e fa una differenza positiva oltre il tuo ruolo

- Opportunità di mobilità globale in oltre 200 paesi in tutto il mondo

- Volontariato e lavoro nei nostri uffici di valutazione Green Star all'avanguardia (quando sei in ufficio) e vestire per la tua giornata

- Pianifichiamo un albero per ogni nuovo dipendente

- Per non parlare dei nostri diversi datori di lavoro di premi di scelta / assegnazioni – WGEA; lavoro inclusivo per la famiglia; datore di lavoro Gold AWEI, Pride nella diversità... per citarne alcuni.

Potremmo andare avanti, ma il punto principale è che Zurigo è un ottimo posto per essere, dove si può veramente appartenere, essere te stesso, avere equilibrio lavoro / vita, e prosperare in un ambiente di supporto.

Zurigo è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Ci impegniamo a garantire che il nostro processo di reclutamento sia equo e accessibile a tutti i candidati. Se avete bisogno di alloggi speciali per partecipare al nostro processo di reclutamento, vi invitiamo a farci sapere al momento della vostra applicazione.

Quindi, se si vuole venire in un'avventura che costruirà un futuro più luminoso insieme, e sentire un senso di insieme, allora si prega di applicare oggi per iniziare la vostra avventura!

Ein neues transformatives Abenteuer erwartet Sie...

Wie bleiben 5 Wochen pro Jahr, eine wirkungsvolle Karriere, die Sie wirklich lieben werden, und die Arbeit für eine vertrauenswürdige Organisation, die das Wohlbefinden stärkt und die digitale Transformation beschleunigt, klingt nach Ihnen?

Als eines der Forbes 2024 "World's Best Employers" und Fortune's "World's Most Admired Companies" für 2025 ist Zurich - ein führendes Unternehmen der Versicherungsbranche - auf dem Weg in eine bessere Zukunft. Eine bessere Zukunft für Sie - konzentriert auf Ihre Karriere, Ihr Wohlbefinden und Ihre Gemeinschaft - sowie unsere Kunden und den Planeten.

Dieses aufregende Abenteuer wird positive Auswirkungen auf unsere Vision haben, Australiens führender digitaler Versicherer zu sein. Wenn Sie also Teil einer werteorientierten globalen Organisation sein wollen, in der echtes Wachstum und Transformation stattfinden, zusammen mit unserer Erfolgsbilanz, einen echten Unterschied zu machen und kontinuierlich Schritte in Richtung einer nachhaltigen Zukunft für unsere Menschen, Kunden, Gemeinschaften und unseren Planeten zu unternehmen ... lesen Sie weiter!

Lasst uns gemeinsam eine bessere Zukunft schaffen, lasst uns einen Unterschied machen

Es ist wichtig zu wissen, was du tust. Bei Zürich decken wir nicht nur ab, wir kümmern uns.

Eine spannende Gelegenheit besteht darin, als Senior Data Analyst in unserem Delegierten Programmteam in das Allgemeine Versicherungsgeschäft von Zürich einzusteigen und an den Partnerships Portfolio Manager zu berichten.

Das GI-Geschäft von Zurich schützt die Mitarbeiter, das Eigentum und den Betrieb unserer Kunden durch eine breite Palette von Einzelhandels- und Gewerbeversicherungslösungen. Innerhalb von GI baut und verwaltet unser Team für delegierte Programme strategische Partnerschaften, die die Reichweite von Zurich erweitern, maßgeschneiderte Angebote liefern und nahtlose Erlebnisse für Endkunden schaffen.

In dieser Funktion verwandeln Sie komplexe Daten in sinnvolle Erkenntnisse, die strategische und operative Entscheidungen in ganz Zürich unterstützen. Sie leiten unabhängig voneinander Analyse-, Berichts- und datengesteuerte Initiativen und arbeiten mit Stakeholdern zusammen, um ihre Bedürfnisse zu verstehen und qualitativ hochwertige, zeitnahe Lösungen zu liefern, die eine echte Geschäftswirkung haben.

Dies ist eine großartige Gelegenheit für einen analytisch orientierten Fachmann, der gerne Probleme löst, Entscheidungen beeinflusst und Teams dabei hilft, Daten konsistent, sicher und konform zu nutzen. Wenn Sie Ihre technischen Fähigkeiten in einem kundenorientierten, kommerziell wichtigen Geschäftsbereich anwenden möchten, könnte dies der nächste Schritt in Ihrer Karriere sein.

Wichtig für Ihren Erfolg - Entsperren Sie Ihr Potenzial

- Starke Erfahrung in der Datenanalyse oder einer damit verbundenen Analyserolle, idealerweise innerhalb von Finanzdienstleistungen oder Versicherungen.

- Confidence führt komplexe Analyseprojekte vom Scoping und der Planung bis hin zur Lieferung.

- Fähigkeit, vertrauenswürdige Beziehungen aufzubauen und leitende Stakeholder in einer beratenden Rolle zu beeinflussen.

- Praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Dashboards, Berichten und Datenmodellen, die eine klare Entscheidungsfindung unterstützen.

- Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit großen Datensätzen und mehreren Datenquellen in einer kontrollierten Umgebung.

- Ein Talent, um Geschäftsfragen in analytische Lösungen und umsetzbare Erkenntnisse zu verwandeln.

Belong. Zürich ist da, um Sie zu unterstützen

Es gibt so viele Gründe, warum Zürich ein großartiger Ort ist und die richtige Wahl für Sie, aber hier sind nur einige.

- 5 Wochen Urlaub pro Jahr für feste Mitarbeiter durch unsere Z-Urlaubsinitiative sowie 15 Tage persönlichen / Pflegeurlaub (da wir unsere Mitarbeiter befähigen, ihr eigenes Wohlbefinden zu verwalten), plus Zugang zu Familienbetreuung (Elternurlaub)

- Hybride Arbeitsvereinbarung - Büro 3 Tage und WFH 2 Tage p/w Standard für FT Mitarbeiter

- Zugang zu Programmen, um gesund zu bleiben und sich gesünder zu fühlen, sowie eine AUD $ 500 Wohlbefindenszahlung pro Jahr, plus einen AUD $ 295 neuen Starter-E-Gutschein für Ihr WFH-Setup (Flex-Arbeit - Hybrid-Arbeiten) und andere große Vorteile durch unser Shine-Portal

- Wachsen und gedeihen Sie in Ihrer Karriere (wir unterstützen und fördern sie) mit preisgekrönten Trainingsprogrammen. Da unsere Stärke unsere Mitarbeiter sind und wir Ihre Individualität schätzen

- Arbeiten Sie mit globalen, vielfältigen und inklusiven Teams zusammen; Entdecken Sie Ihre Leidenschaften, fördern Sie Innovationen, fördern Sie Gerechtigkeit, arbeiten Sie zusammen und machen Sie einen positiven Unterschied über Ihre Rolle hinaus

- Globale Mobilitätsmöglichkeiten in mehr als 200 Ländern weltweit

- Freiwilligenarbeit und Arbeit in unseren hochmodernen Green Star Büros (wenn Sie im Büro sind) und Kleid für Ihren Tag

- Wir pflanzen einen Baum für jeden neuen Mitarbeiter

- Ganz zu schweigen von unseren verschiedenen Arbeitgeberpreisen / Mitgliedschaften - WGEA; Family Inclusive Arbeitsplatz; Gold AWEI Arbeitgeber, Stolz auf Vielfalt ... um nur einige zu nennen.

Wir könnten weitermachen, aber der Hauptpunkt ist, dass Zürich ein großartiger Ort ist, an dem Sie wirklich dazugehören, Sie selbst sein, eine Work-Life-Balance haben und in einer unterstützenden Umgebung gedeihen können.

Zürich ist ein Arbeitgeber der Chancengleichheit. Wir setzen uns dafür ein, dass unser Rekrutierungsprozess fair und für alle Kandidaten zugänglich ist. Wenn Sie spezielle Unterkünfte benötigen, um an unserem Rekrutierungsprozess teilzunehmen, empfehlen wir Ihnen, uns dies zum Zeitpunkt Ihrer Bewerbung mitzuteilen.

Wenn Sie also auf ein Abenteuer kommen möchten, das gemeinsam eine bessere Zukunft aufbauen und ein Gefühl der Zusammengehörigkeit spüren wird, dann bewerben Sie sich bitte noch heute, um Ihr Abenteuer zu beginnen!

descriptionByLocale.en:
A new transformational adventure awaits you…

How does 5 weeks of annual leave, a fulfilling career you'll genuinely enjoy, and working for a reputable organization that promotes wellbeing and drives digital transformation sound to you?

As one of Forbes 2024 ‘World’s Best Employers’ and Fortune’s ‘World’s Most Admired Companies’ for 2025, Zurich - a leader in the insurance industry, is on a journey towards a brighter future… A brighter future for you - focused on your career, your wellbeing, and your community - as well as our customers and the planet.

Join us on this thrilling journey as we work towards our vision of becoming Australia's leading digital insurer. If you're eager to be part of a values-driven global organisation that's experiencing real growth and transformation, and if you share our commitment to making a tangible difference and taking continuous steps towards a sustainable future for our people, customers, communities, and our planet, then keep reading!

Let’s create a brighter future together, let’s make a difference

It’s important to know, what you do matters. At Zurich, we don’t just cover, we care.

In this role, you’ll play a key part in supporting customers during some of life’s most challenging moments. As a Claims Consultant within our Retail Life business, you will be responsible for assessing and managing a portfolio of Retail Income Protection claims, with fairness, empathy, and professionalism. Your work will contribute to timely, accurate decisions that help deliver certainty to customers when they need it most. You will also have the opportunity to expand your skills in other areas of Life Insurance claims such as TPD, Trauma, and Terminal Illness.

You will also be responsible for the following:

- Manage the end-to-end claims process with a proactive and customer-focused approach.

- Analyse medical, financial, and policy information to make fair and timely claim decisions.

- Communicate clearly with customers and stakeholders to keep them informed throughout the process.

- Build positive relationships with internal teams and external providers to support better claim outcomes.

- Prepare accurate documentation and maintain high-quality file management.

- Identify opportunities to improve claims processes and support continuous enhancement.

- Uplift the capabilities of our claims administrators by developing their knowledge and skills across the claims management process.

Important to your success - let's grow together

You’re someone who brings empathy, sound judgment, and a calm, organised approach to complex situations. You collaborate with care, communicate with clarity, and understand the importance of delivering a genuine human experience to every customer and stakeholder.

In order to be successful, you will have the following:

- Experience with end-to-end assessment of retail income protection claims. A background in workers’ compensation or injury management also relevant.

- Understanding of life insurance policies, products, and regulatory requirements.

- Ability to interpret medical, legal, and financial information to support decision-making.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills across diverse audiences.

- Proven ability to manage competing priorities and maintain accuracy under pressure.

- Proficiency with claims systems, documentation processes, and digital tools.

- A commitment to continuous improvement.

Belong. Zurich is here to support you

There are so many reasons why Zurich is a great place to be and the right choice for you, but here are just a few.

- Enjoy 5 weeks of annual leave for permanent staff through our Z leave initiative, along with 15 days of personal/carer’s leave as we empower our people to manage their own wellbeing. Plus, access to Family Care (parental leave).

- Benefit from a hybrid working arrangement – 3 days in the office and 2 days working from home per week for full-time employees.

- Access programs to stay healthy and feel healthier, receive an AUD$500 wellbeing payment per year, and a AUD$295 new starter e-voucher for your work-from-home setup (flex work - hybrid working), along with other great benefits through our Shine portal.

- Grow and thrive in your career with our award-winning training programs. We support and encourage your development because our strength lies in our people, and we value your individuality.

- Work with global, diverse, and inclusive teams; explore your passions, fuel innovation, drive equity, collaborate, and make a positive difference beyond your role.

- Take advantage of global mobility opportunities across more than 200 countries worldwide.

- Volunteer and work in our state-of-the-art Green Star rated offices (when you are in the office) and dress for your day.

- We plant a tree for every new employee.

- Not to mention our various employer of choice awards/memberships – WGEA; Family Inclusive Workplace; Gold AWEI Employer, Pride in Diversity… to name a few.

We could go on, but the main point is that Zurich is a great place to be, where you can truly belong, be yourself, maintain work/life balance, and thrive in a supportive environment.

Zurich is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to ensuring that our recruitment process is fair and accessible for all candidates. If you require any special accommodations to participate in our recruitment process, we encourage you to please let us know at the time of your application.

So, if you want to come on an adventure that will build a brighter future together, and feel a sense of togetherness, then please apply today to start your adventure!

Una nuova avventura trasformazionale vi aspetta...

Come fa 5 settimane di congedo annuale, una carriera soddisfacente ti piacerà davvero, e lavorare per un'organizzazione rispettabile che promuove il benessere e guida il suono di trasformazione digitale a te?

Come uno dei Forbes 2024 ‘World’s Best Employers’ e ‘World’s Most Admired Companies’ di Fortune per il 2025, Zurigo - leader nel settore assicurativo, è in un viaggio verso un futuro più luminoso... Un futuro più luminoso per voi - focalizzato sulla vostra carriera, il vostro benessere, e la vostra comunità - così come i nostri clienti e il pianeta.

Unisciti a noi in questo viaggio emozionante mentre lavoriamo verso la nostra visione di diventare l'insurretore digitale leader dell'Australia. Se siete desiderosi di far parte di un'organizzazione globale orientata ai valori che sta vivendo una reale crescita e trasformazione, e se condividete il nostro impegno a fare una differenza tangibile e a compiere passi continui verso un futuro sostenibile per la nostra gente, clienti, comunità e il nostro pianeta, continuate a leggere!

Creiamo un futuro più luminoso insieme, facciamo la differenza

E 'importante sapere, quello che fai conta. A Zurigo, non basta coprire, ci interessa.

In questo ruolo, si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nel supportare i clienti durante alcuni dei momenti più impegnativi della vita. In qualità di consulente legale all'interno del nostro business di vita al dettaglio, sarai responsabile della valutazione e della gestione di un portafoglio di reclami per la protezione dei redditi al dettaglio, con correttezza, empatia e professionalità. Il vostro lavoro contribuirà a decisioni tempestive e accurate che aiutano a garantire ai clienti quando ne hanno più bisogno. Avrete anche la possibilità di espandere le vostre competenze in altre aree di Life Insurance rivendicazioni come TPD, Trauma e Terminal Illness.

Sarete anche responsabili per quanto segue:

- Gestire il processo di reclamo end-to-end con un approccio proattivo e focalizzato sul cliente.

- Analizzare le informazioni mediche, finanziarie e politiche per prendere decisioni giuste e tempestive.

- Comunicare chiaramente con i clienti e gli stakeholder per tenerli informati durante il processo.

- Costruire relazioni positive con i team interni e i fornitori esterni per sostenere i migliori risultati di reclamo.

- Preparare la documentazione accurata e mantenere la gestione dei file di alta qualità.

- Identificare le opportunità per migliorare i processi di reclamo e sostenere il miglioramento continuo.

- Elevare le capacità dei nostri amministratori crediti sviluppando le loro conoscenze e competenze attraverso il processo di gestione dei crediti.

Importante per il vostro successo - cresciamo insieme

Sei qualcuno che porta empatia, giudizio sonoro, e un approccio calmo e organizzato a situazioni complesse. Collaborate con cura, comunicate con chiarezza e comprendete l'importanza di offrire un'esperienza umana genuina ad ogni cliente e stakeholder.

Per avere successo, avrai le seguenti:

- Esperienza con la valutazione end-to-end dei crediti di protezione del reddito al dettaglio. Un background nella compensazione dei lavoratori o nella gestione delle lesioni anche rilevante.

- Comprensione delle politiche di assicurazione sulla vita, dei prodotti e dei requisiti normativi.

- Capacità di interpretare informazioni mediche, legali e finanziarie per sostenere il processo decisionale.

- Forte capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale attraverso il pubblico vario.

- Prove capacità di gestire le priorità concorrenti e mantenere l'accuratezza sotto pressione.

- Competenza con sistemi di reclamo, processi di documentazione e strumenti digitali.

- Impegno al miglioramento continuo.

Da un po'. Zurigo è qui per sostenervi

Ci sono tanti motivi per cui Zurigo è un ottimo posto per essere e la scelta giusta per voi, ma qui ci sono solo alcuni.

- Approfitta di 5 settimane di congedo annuale per il personale permanente attraverso la nostra iniziativa di congedo Z, insieme a 15 giorni di congedo personale/carer, in modo che il nostro popolo possa gestire il proprio benessere. Inoltre, l'accesso a Family Care (partita genitoriale).

- Approfitta di un accordo di lavoro ibrido – 3 giorni in ufficio e 2 giorni di lavoro da casa a settimana per i dipendenti a tempo pieno.

- Programmi di accesso per rimanere sano e sentirsi più sano, ricevere un pagamento di benessere AUD$500 all'anno, e un nuovo e-voucher AUD$295 per il vostro lavoro-da-home setup (lavoro flessibile - lavoro ibrido), insieme ad altri grandi benefici attraverso il nostro portale Shine.

- Crescere e prosperare nella tua carriera con i nostri programmi di formazione pluripremiati. Sosteniamo e incoraggiamo il vostro sviluppo perché la nostra forza è nella nostra gente, e apprezziamo la vostra individualità.

- Lavorare con team globali, diversi e inclusivi; esplorare le vostre passioni, innovazione del carburante, guidare l'equità, collaborare e fare una differenza positiva al di là del vostro ruolo.

- Approfitta delle opportunità di mobilità globale in oltre 200 paesi in tutto il mondo.

- Volontariato e lavoro nei nostri uffici all'avanguardia Green Star (quando sei in ufficio) e vestire per la tua giornata.

- Pianifichiamo un albero per ogni nuovo dipendente.

- Per non parlare dei nostri diversi datori di lavoro di assegnazioni / borse di studio – WGEA; Family Inclusive Workplace; Gold AWEI Employer, Pride in Diversity... per citarne alcuni.

Potremmo andare avanti, ma il punto principale è che Zurigo è un ottimo posto per essere, dove si può veramente appartenere, essere te stesso, mantenere l'equilibrio lavoro / vita, e prosperare in un ambiente di supporto.

Zurigo è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Ci impegniamo a garantire che il nostro processo di reclutamento sia equo e accessibile a tutti i candidati. Se avete bisogno di alloggi speciali per partecipare al nostro processo di reclutamento, vi invitiamo a farci sapere al momento della vostra applicazione.

Quindi, se si vuole venire in un'avventura che costruirà un futuro più luminoso insieme, e sentire un senso di insieme, quindi si prega di applicare oggi per iniziare la vostra avventura!

Ein neues transformatives Abenteuer erwartet Sie...

Wie klingen 5 Wochen Jahresurlaub, eine erfüllende Karriere, die Sie wirklich genießen werden, und die Arbeit für eine seriöse Organisation, die das Wohlbefinden fördert und die digitale Transformation vorantreibt?

Als eines der Forbes 2024 "World's Best Employers" und Fortune's "World's Most Admired Companies" für 2025 ist Zurich - ein führendes Unternehmen der Versicherungsbranche - auf dem Weg in eine bessere Zukunft. Eine bessere Zukunft für Sie - konzentriert auf Ihre Karriere, Ihr Wohlbefinden und Ihre Gemeinschaft - sowie unsere Kunden und den Planeten.

Begleiten Sie uns auf dieser aufregenden Reise, während wir auf unsere Vision hinarbeiten, Australiens führender digitaler Versicherer zu werden. Wenn Sie Teil einer werteorientierten globalen Organisation sein möchten, die echtes Wachstum und Transformation erlebt, und wenn Sie unser Engagement teilen, einen spürbaren Unterschied zu machen und kontinuierliche Schritte in Richtung einer nachhaltigen Zukunft für unsere Mitarbeiter, Kunden, Gemeinschaften und unseren Planeten zu unternehmen, dann lesen Sie weiter!

Lasst uns gemeinsam eine bessere Zukunft schaffen, lasst uns einen Unterschied machen

Es ist wichtig zu wissen, was du tust. Bei Zürich decken wir nicht nur ab, wir kümmern uns.

In dieser Rolle spielen Sie eine wichtige Rolle bei der Unterstützung von Kunden in einigen der herausforderndsten Momente des Lebens. Als Claims Consultant in unserem Retail Life-Geschäft sind Sie für die Bewertung und Verwaltung eines Portfolios von Retail Income Protection-Ansprüchen mit Fairness, Empathie und Professionalität verantwortlich. Ihre Arbeit wird zu zeitnahen, genauen Entscheidungen beitragen, die den Kunden Sicherheit bieten, wenn sie sie am dringendsten benötigen. Sie haben auch die Möglichkeit, Ihre Fähigkeiten in anderen Bereichen der Lebensversicherung Ansprüche wie TPD, Trauma und Terminal Krankheit zu erweitern.

Sie sind auch für Folgendes verantwortlich:

- Verwalten Sie den End-to-End-Claim-Prozess mit einem proaktiven und kundenorientierten Ansatz.

- Analysieren Sie medizinische, finanzielle und politische Informationen, um faire und rechtzeitige Anspruchsentscheidungen zu treffen.

- Kommunizieren Sie klar mit Kunden und Stakeholdern, um sie während des gesamten Prozesses zu informieren.

- Bauen Sie positive Beziehungen zu internen Teams und externen Anbietern auf, um bessere Claim-Ergebnisse zu erzielen.

- Erstellen Sie eine genaue Dokumentation und pflegen Sie eine qualitativ hochwertige Dateiverwaltung.

- Identifizieren Sie Möglichkeiten zur Verbesserung der Schadenprozesse und unterstützen Sie die kontinuierliche Verbesserung.

- Erhöhen Sie die Fähigkeiten unserer Schadenverwalter, indem Sie ihre Kenntnisse und Fähigkeiten im gesamten Schadenmanagementprozess weiterentwickeln.

Wichtig für Ihren Erfolg - wachsen wir zusammen

Du bist jemand, der Empathie, gesundes Urteilsvermögen und eine ruhige, organisierte Herangehensweise an komplexe Situationen mitbringt. Sie arbeiten mit Sorgfalt zusammen, kommunizieren mit Klarheit und verstehen, wie wichtig es ist, jedem Kunden und Stakeholder eine echte menschliche Erfahrung zu bieten.

Um erfolgreich zu sein, haben Sie Folgendes:

- Erfahrung mit der End-to-End-Bewertung von Einkommensschutzforderungen für Privatkunden. Ein Hintergrund in der Arbeitnehmer Entschädigung oder Verletzungsmanagement auch relevant.

- Verständnis von Lebensversicherungen, Produkten und regulatorischen Anforderungen.

- Fähigkeit, medizinische, rechtliche und finanzielle Informationen zu interpretieren, um die Entscheidungsfindung zu unterstützen.

- Starke schriftliche und verbale Kommunikationsfähigkeiten über verschiedene Zielgruppen hinweg.

- Bewährte Fähigkeit, konkurrierende Prioritäten zu verwalten und Genauigkeit unter Druck zu halten.

- Kenntnisse in Anspruchssystemen, Dokumentationsprozessen und digitalen Tools.

- Eine Verpflichtung zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung.

Belong. Zürich ist da, um Sie zu unterstützen

Es gibt so viele Gründe, warum Zürich ein großartiger Ort ist und die richtige Wahl für Sie, aber hier sind nur einige.

- Genießen Sie 5 Wochen Jahresurlaub für ständige Mitarbeiter durch unsere Z-Urlaubsinitiative, zusammen mit 15 Tagen persönlichen / Pflegeurlaub, während wir unsere Mitarbeiter befähigen, ihr eigenes Wohlbefinden zu verwalten. Plus, Zugang zur Familienbetreuung (Elternurlaub).

- Profitieren Sie von einer hybriden Arbeitsvereinbarung - 3 Tage im Büro und 2 Tage Arbeit von zu Hause pro Woche für Vollzeitmitarbeiter.

- Zugang zu Programmen, um gesund zu bleiben und sich gesünder zu fühlen, erhalten eine AUD $ 500 Wohlbefindenszahlung pro Jahr und einen AUD $ 295 neuen Starter-E-Gutschein für Ihr Work-from-Home-Setup (Flex-Arbeit - Hybrid-Arbeit), zusammen mit anderen großen Vorteilen durch unser Shine-Portal.

- Wachsen und gedeihen Sie in Ihrer Karriere mit unseren preisgekrönten Trainingsprogrammen. Wir unterstützen und fördern Ihre Entwicklung, weil unsere Stärke in unseren Mitarbeitern liegt und wir Ihre Individualität schätzen.

- Arbeiten Sie mit globalen, vielfältigen und integrativen Teams zusammen; entdecken Sie Ihre Leidenschaften, fördern Sie Innovationen, fördern Sie Gerechtigkeit, arbeiten Sie zusammen und machen Sie einen positiven Unterschied über Ihre Rolle hinaus.

- Nutzen Sie globale Mobilitätsmöglichkeiten in mehr als 200 Ländern weltweit.

- Freiwillige und arbeiten Sie in unseren hochmodernen Green Star Büros (wenn Sie im Büro sind) und kleiden Sie sich für Ihren Tag.

- Wir pflanzen einen Baum für jeden neuen Mitarbeiter.

- Ganz zu schweigen von unseren verschiedenen Arbeitgeberpreisen / Mitgliedschaften - WGEA; Family Inclusive Workplace; Gold AWEI Arbeitgeber, Stolz auf Vielfalt ... um nur einige zu nennen.

Wir könnten weitermachen, aber der Hauptpunkt ist, dass Zürich ein großartiger Ort ist, an dem Sie wirklich dazugehören, Sie selbst sein, die Work-Life-Balance aufrechterhalten und in einer unterstützenden Umgebung gedeihen können.

Zürich ist ein Arbeitgeber der Chancengleichheit. Wir setzen uns dafür ein, dass unser Rekrutierungsprozess fair und für alle Kandidaten zugänglich ist. Wenn Sie spezielle Unterkünfte benötigen, um an unserem Rekrutierungsprozess teilzunehmen, empfehlen wir Ihnen, uns dies zum Zeitpunkt Ihrer Bewerbung mitzuteilen.

Wenn Sie also auf ein Abenteuer kommen möchten, das gemeinsam eine bessere Zukunft aufbauen und ein Gefühl der Zusammengehörigkeit spüren wird, dann bewerben Sie sich bitte noch heute, um Ihr Abenteuer zu beginnen!

descriptionByLocale.de:
コンタクトセンターオペレーター（スーパーバイザー・スーパーバイザー候補）

採用背景

- ダイレクトビジネスに主軸を置く同社において、重要ポジションとなるコンタクトセンターでの業務拡大により増員となります
- ※今回は管理者候補の採用です。フィンテックの進化やデジタル化の加速に対応し、新しい価値をお客様に届けるための変革を推進しています
- ※オペレーションの簡素化やAIを活用した業務効率化を進め、より高品質なカスタマーサービスを実現します。こうした変化に前向きに取り組み、新しい仕組みやテクノロジーを柔軟に取り入れられる方を歓迎します。

職務内容

- 当社のコンタクトセンターで、お客様からのお問い合わせに対応し、契約や各種手続きをサポートしていただきます。
- 電話・メール・LINE・チャットなど、幅広いチャネルを活用しながら、お客様の「安心」を支えるお仕事です。
- カスタマーハラスメント対策ガイドラインを整備しており、従業員を守る体制が整っています。

入社後の流れ

- 2～3か月間の充実した研修をご用意しています。
- 商品知識やシステム操作、応対スキルをしっかり学んだうえで現場デビューできます。
- 研修後も、先輩やSVによるフォロー体制が整っており、安心して業務に取り組めます。

具体的には

- 保険料や補償内容のご案内、見積書の作成、契約手続きのサポート
- 契約内容の変更や解約など、ライフステージに応じた保全手続き
- 保険証券や異動承認書の発行など、正確でスピーディーな事務処理

必須スキル・人物像

- 販売・接客経験者
- 基本的なPCスキル（Word・Excelなど）をお持ちの方
- 人と関わることが好きで、相手の気持ちを理解しながら対応できる方
- チームで協力しながら仕事を進められる方
- ルールを守り、正確さを大切にできる方
- 新しいことを学ぶ意欲があり、前向きに取り組める方
- 自分で考え、主体的に行動できる方
- 柔軟性があり、積極的に物事に取り組める方

歓迎スキル・経験

- 損害保険業界での業務経験
- コンタクトセンターやコールセンターでの勤務経験（業界不問）
- チームリーダーやSVとしてのマネジメント経験
- PC操作や複数システムを使った業務経験

キャリアアップ・働きやすさ

- 未経験でも3年後に、経験者であれば2年後にSVを目指せる明確なキャリアパスを用意しています。
- 入社1年以内： お客さま対応スキル、業務遂行スキルを習得
- 入社2年目～ リーダー職として新人研修参加、後進育成、プロジェクトにメンバーとして参画する
- 入社3年～ コールセンター管理者（SV）として、新人研修講師を担当。
- SVチームメンバーのスキルアップに責任を持つ、プロジェクトにチームリーダーとして参画する。

待遇

給与
- 当社規程により決定
- ☆前職の経験/スキルを考慮

勤務時間
- 労働時間区分：シフト制
- 就業時間：9時00分から18時00分の間で実働7時間・休憩1時間のシフト勤務
- 補足事項：土日祝を含むシフト勤務制(週5日勤務)

休日休暇
- 完全週休2日制、年次有給休暇(半日・一部1時間単位取得可能)、リフレッシュ休暇、年末年始休暇、慶弔休暇、ほか ☆2024年年間休日実績 123日

福利厚生
- 各種社会保険(健康、厚生年金、雇用、労災、ほか)、団体生命保険、会員制福利厚生クラブ、育児休職制度、介護休職制度、退職年金制度、財形貯蓄制度、社内クラブ活動ほか

契約期間
- 期間定めなし
- 試用期間あり（6か月）

勤務地
- 大阪オフィス
- 〒560-0082 大阪府豊中市新千里東町 1-5-3 千里朝日阪急ビル 19 階
- 喫煙：屋内原則禁煙（喫煙室有り）

補足情報

勤務時間
- 労働時間区分：シフト制
- 就業時間：9:00～17:00（所定労働時間：7時間）
- 補足事項：土日祝を含むシフト勤務制(週5日勤務)

休日休暇
- 週休 2 日制
- 年次有給休暇、年末年始休暇、慶弔休暇、フレキシブル連続休暇、ボランティア休暇、永年勤続休暇など
- ☆2022年年間休日実績 123日

福利厚生
- 各種社会保険(健康、厚生年金、雇用、労災、他)、団体生命保険、会員制福利厚生クラブ、財形貯蓄制度、社内クラブ活動ほか

その他

- まずはオペレーターとして経験を積み、その後は入社後2年程度を目処に、オペレーターの育成やエスカレーション対応等のチーム内の実務管理を担う「スーパーバイザー」を目指してください。

応募方法

選考をご希望の方はエントリーの際に、以下をシステム上にてご提出お願い致します。

提出書類
- 履歴書
- 職務経歴書

※システム上にて提出できない方は以下のメールアドレスまでご送付ください

提出先
- recruit_sh@zurich.co.jp

今すぐ応募する »

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione

本ポジションは当社の戦略プロジェクトおよび保守開発を実行するため、損害サービス領域専属のビジネスアナリストとしてアサインされる予定のものです。ビジネス部門の戦略・ビジョンを理解し、システム開発プロセスの上流工程からビジネス・IT双方をリードすることがミッションです.
プロジェクトの終了後は当社のアプリケーション構築およびソリューションをデPer saperne di piùーションなどコミュニケーションスキルを駆使して、ITシステム開発担当者へ説明し、十分な理解を定着させ、ITソリューションの提供に責任を持ちます.

Missioni

- 戦略プロジェクトおよび保守開発を実行
-ビジネス部門の戦略・ビジョンを理解し、システム開発プロセスの上流工程からビジネス・IT双方をリード
-プロジェクトの終了後、アプリケーション構築およびソリューションをデリバリーするチームの一員として、ソリューション要件を説明し、ITシステム開発担当者への理解を確保

Compiti e responsabilità chiave

- ビジネス要件の引き出し、要件定義
- ユーザー要件の収集および正確な理解
-ビジネスのニーズを解した上で、適切かつ十分なビジネス要件を引き出してシステム要件へと定義
- システム要件を関係するITの各担当者へ説明し、十分な理解を図る
- 解決策の提案
-ビジネス上の戦略・ビジョンを理解し、要求抽出・分析を実施した上でITの場からソリューションを提案
-プロアクティブなワークショップやミーティングの企画・主導、将来ニーズを見据えた情報収集
- プロダクトのビジョン・ロードマップ策定、進捗管理、アジャイル開発への参画
- ユーザーインタビューやユーザビリティテストによる実態把握と要件反映
- KPIの定義およびパフォーマンス評価への活用
- 戦略プロジェクトの遂行
- Guidewire Claim Center, に関する要件定義、務設計、Fit & Gap分析移行に伴う周
- 周辺システムとの連携・業務影響整理おゖ
-ビジネス部門・IT部門・外部ベンダー等、国内外の多様なステークホルダーとの調整・合意形成
- 種ドキュメント作成（エピック、ユーザーストーリー、業務フロー、等

Qualifiche/Esperienza

必須経験・スキル
- Guidewire ClaimCenter, に関する要件定義、開発経験
-
-システム移行・刷新プロジェクトでのビジネスアナリスト、または上流SEとしての実務経験
- パッケージソリューション（Guidewire等）の制約と業務要件のFit & Gap
-ビジネス部門・IT部門・他ステークホルダーと円滑に会話し、ニーズや期待を引き出すコミュニケーション力
- セルフスターターで、情熱と責任感を持って積極的かつ誠実に仕事に取り組める方
- 論理的思考能力に強みがあり、分析と問題解決能力が高いこと
- 多様な関係者と合意形成を図るファシリテーションスキル
- 論理的思考力と課題解決力
- 日本語でのビジネス会話、および読み書き

あればより良い経験・スキル
- Guidewire ClaimCenterの導入・運用・クラウド移行経験
- ビジネスプロセス改革（BPR）や業務改善の実践経験
- アジャイル型開発プロジェクト経験
-
- 多国籍・多様なバックグラウンドの関係者と柔軟かつ前向きに協働できる方
-新しい領域や技術に積極的にチャレンジできる方
- チームワークを大切にし、ゴール達成に向けて周囲と協力できる方
- 顧客視点・現場視点を常に意識できる方

descriptionByLocale.en:
A new transformational adventure awaits you…

How does 5 weeks of annual leave, a fulfilling career you'll genuinely enjoy, and working for a reputable organization that promotes wellbeing and drives digital transformation sound to you?

As one of Forbes 2024 ‘World’s Best Employers’ and Fortune’s ‘World’s Most Admired Companies’ for 2025, Zurich - a leader in the insurance industry, is on a journey towards a brighter future… A brighter future for you - focused on your career, your wellbeing, and your community - as well as our customers and the planet.

Join us on this thrilling journey as we work towards our vision of becoming Australia's leading digital insurer. If you're eager to be part of a values-driven global organisation that's experiencing real growth and transformation, and if you share our commitment to making a tangible difference and taking continuous steps towards a sustainable future for our people, customers, communities, and our planet, then keep reading!

Let’s create a brighter future together, let’s make a difference

It’s important to know, what you do matters. At Zurich, we don’t just cover, we care.

As Client Partner Lead – Property Risk Engineering, you will play a senior technical leadership role within Zurich Resilience Solutions, partnering with some of our largest and most complex property customers. This role exists to deepen Zurich’s technical engagement, strengthen resilience outcomes, and ensure customers receive trusted, high ‑ quality risk engineering insight that supports safer, more sustainable operations.

Sitting within the Property Line of Business, you will balance deep technical expertise with strong client partnership, acting as a trusted advisor to customers, brokers and internal stakeholders while shaping how Zurich delivers risk engineering solutions across complex portfolios.

You will also be responsible for the following:

descriptionByLocale.en:
Zurich is currently looking for a Pricing Actuary or Senior Actuarial Analyst II to join National Accounts and work out of our Chicago Office. This colleague will support and work alongside the market facing underwriting teams in our Domestic Casualty unit, as well as supporting other Business Unit initiatives.

Through this collaborative, cross functional business partnership, the National Accounts Pricing team improves the financial understanding and performance of accounts within the regions and enhances the quality of technical underwriting, decision making and risk selection. They are instrumental in profitably growing the premium volume on both a regional and company level. This individual will be responsible for supporting the field underwriting needs of the Midwest Region.

As Associate Actuary, you will be a primary point of contact and resource for the Midwest Region, its underwriters, and underwriting managers. In this individual contributor role, you will work independently on account pricing as well as lead more complex analytical work. Examples of this include:

- Assisting with the development of account-based model pricing structures and leveraging profitability analysis

- Partnering with regional business leaders and underwriters on both transactional and strategic account decisions; most notably by providing actuarial calculations, including:

- Risk transfer analysis

- Large complex loss forecasts and unique rating plan structure

- Large account collateral needs

- Supporting and training underwriters in pricing and loss forecasting concepts, model outputs and tools, and providing a feedback channel to ensure the issues faced by the tool users are being addressed by the tool designers

- Participating in internal audits and occasional meetings with brokers, outside actuarial consultants, and/or customers

- Understanding profit drivers on portfolio and book segments and communicating insights as needed

- Providing leadership with recommendations on key parts of the large account book of business to help drive strategic profit and growth

- Developing strategic partnerships with the business segment leadership, portfolio managers, and underwriters

- Helping underwriters craft a story and support the deal proposal with sound rationale for rate increases, term changes, coverage adjustments, etc. beyond “the model says so”

- Managing the demands of the various stakeholders, ensuring predictable and timely completion of work.

This is an opportunity to gain broad exposure to our various casualty lines of business, business segments and customers/prospects. You will also gain valuable underwriting insights and business knowledge working within an underwriting framework. As part of the expectations in this role, you will remain current with regulatory/market conditions to apply this knowledge in pricing solutions and recommendations.

This role will be filled at either the Associate Actuary or Senior Actuarial Analyst II Level. The hiring manager will determine the appropriate level based upon the selected applicant’s experience and skill set relative to the qualifications listed for this position.

Basic Qualifications:

Associate Actuary:

- Bachelors Degree in Mathematics/Statistics or Actuarial Sciences and 5 or more years of experience in the Actuarial area
AND

- ACAS or equivalent international certification

OR

Senior Actuarial Analyst II:

- Zurich Certified Insurance Apprentice, including Associates Degree
OR

- Bachelors Degree
AND

- 5 or more years of experience in the Actuarial area plus FCAS or equivalent international certification
OR

- 10 or more years of experience in the Actuarial area plus ACAS or equivalent international certification

Preferred Qualifications:

- Experience in multiple functional areas (pricing, reserving, capital management) and knowledge/skills reflective of a senior practitioner

- Strong verbal and written communication skills

Your pay at Zurich is based on your role, location, skills, and experience. We follow local laws to ensure fair compensation. You may also be eligible for bonuses and merit increases. If your expectations are above the listed range, we still encourage you to apply—your unique background matters to us. The combined salary range for this position is $126,700.00 - $238,700.00. The proposed salary range for the Senior Actuarial Analyst II is $126,700.00 - $207,600.00, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 15%. The proposed salary range for the Pricing Actuary is $145,800.00 - $238,700.00, with short-term incentive bonus eligibility set at 20%.

We offer competitive pay and comprehensive benefits for employees and their families. [Learn more about Total Rewards here .]

Why Zurich?

At Zurich, we value your ideas and experience. We offer growth, inclusion, and a supportive environment—so you can help shape the future of insurance. Zurich North America is a leader in risk management, with over 150 years of expertise and coverage across 25+ industries, including 90% of the Fortune 500®.

Join us for a brighter future—for yourself and our customers.

Zurich in North America does not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information, age, disability, protected veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, pregnancy or other characteristics protected by applicable law. Equal Opportunity Employer disability/vets.

Zurich complies with 18 U.S. Code § 1033.

Zurich sucht derzeit einen Pricing Actuary oder Senior Actuarial Analyst II, der sich National Accounts anschließt und von unserem Büro in Chicago aus arbeitet. Dieser Kollege wird die versicherungstechnischen Teams in unserer Einheit für inländische Unfälle unterstützen und mit ihnen zusammenarbeiten sowie andere Initiativen der Business Unit unterstützen.

Durch diese kollaborative, funktionsübergreifende Geschäftspartnerschaft verbessert das National Accounts Pricing Team das finanzielle Verständnis und die Performance von Konten in den Regionen und verbessert die Qualität von technischem Underwriting, Entscheidungsfindung und Risikoauswahl. Als Associate Actuary sind Sie eine primäre Anlaufstelle und Ressource für die Midwest Region, ihre Underwriter und Underwriting-Manager. In dieser Rolle des einzelnen Mitwirkenden arbeiten Sie selbstständig an der Kontopreisgestaltung und führen komplexere analytische Arbeiten. Beispiele hierfür sind:

- Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung von kontobasierten Modellpreisstrukturen und Nutzung der Rentabilitätsanalyse

- Zusammenarbeit mit regionalen Wirtschaftsführern und Underwritern bei transaktionalen und strategischen Kontoentscheidungen; insbesondere durch versicherungsmathematische Berechnungen, einschließlich:

- Risikotransferanalyse

- Große komplexe Verlustprognosen und einzigartige Ratingplanstruktur

- Anforderungen an Großkundensicherheiten

- Unterstützung und Schulung von Underwritern in Preis- und Verlustprognosekonzepten, Modellergebnissen und Tools sowie Bereitstellung eines Feedback-Kanals, um sicherzustellen, dass die Probleme der Tool-Benutzer von den Tool-Designern angegangen werden

- Teilnahme an internen Audits und gelegentlichen Treffen mit Maklern, externen Versicherungsmathematikern und / oder Kunden

- Verwaltung der Anforderungen der verschiedenen Interessengruppen, Gewährleistung eines vorhersehbaren und rechtzeitigen Abschlusses der Arbeiten.
